subject: Billpack creator & distribution preference for NovaTech (PO 78345)
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novatech.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@novatech.com
Date: 2027-11-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billpack creator & distribution — PO 78345 (preference)

Hi Soojin,

We're getting set to accept invoices for PO 78345. Our AP team has two requirements and they'd like your recommendation:

1) Who will be the invoice creator on Redwood's side (billpack/originator)? We need that name and remit address to match our PO.
2) Distribution preference: our AP system prefers a single emailed PDF to ap@novatech.com, but some internal teams want invoices delivered to a portal webhook for automated posting.

We also need VAT breakdown on the invoice (line-level tax) and a copy of a sample invoice in XML for our ERP. I've attached the PO.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Senior AP Analyst | NovaTech
[Attachment: NovaTech_PO_78345.pdf (application/pdf, 86 KB)]
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novatech.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-11-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billpack creator & distribution — PO 78345 (preference)

Hi Lena — thanks for the PO and clear ask. Quick answers up front, then proposed approach: 

- Invoice originator: Redwood Inference (we can sign invoices as "Redwood Inference Ltd." or a specific billing entity. If NovaTech requires a specific remit/pay-to, tell us the exact legal name to put in the header).
- Distribution: we support both single-email PDF to ap@novatech.com and direct portal/webhook delivery (or both). For AP systems that require an emailed PDF as the legal record we recommend sending the PDF to ap@novatech.com and also pushing machine-readable XML to your portal/webhook for ERP ingest. That gives a human-friendly copy and an automated feed for reconciliation.
- VAT: we will include line-level VAT and summary totals. For reverse-charge scenarios please confirm your VAT ID so we can tag it correctly.

Next steps I suggest: Marissa can produce a sample PDF + XML (sample invoice) showing the line-level VAT and the biller name options; Connor can draft the header wording for remit/short pay-to. If that sounds good I'll loop them in and attach the sample files.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-11-08T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billpack creator & distribution — PO 78345 (preference)

Hi Lena — attaching the artifacts for review.

Summary of attachments:
- redwood-sample-invoice.pdf — human-readable invoice showing two biller options: (A) Redwood Inference, Inc. (US remit address) and (B) Redwood Inference Ltd. (EU legal entity).
- redwood-sample-invoice-xml.xml — our ERP-friendly XML payload; includes VAT elements and a <Tax> block per line.
- sample-webhook-spec.txt — describes the JSON we will POST to your portal (includes invoice_id, net, tax, gross, PO ref).

We recommend the hybrid approach: email PDF to ap@novatech.com (legal/archive copy) + POST XML/JSON to your portal endpoint for automated ingestion. If NovaTech cannot accept POSTs, we'll provide an SFTP push of XML nightly.

A couple of clarifying Qs for NovaTech:
- Please confirm which legal name to print on the "Bill From" line.
- Please confirm NovaTech VAT ID (for reverse charge handling).
- If you use PO matching tolerance rules (e.g. 2% price variance), let us know so we can surface it on the invoice.

[Attachments: redwood-sample-invoice.pdf (application/pdf, 48 KB), redwood-sample-invoice-xml.xml (application/xml, 6 KB), sample-webhook-spec.txt (text/plain, 3 KB)]

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Accounting Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@novatech.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-11-09T15:40:00-07:00

All — this is perfect, thanks.

Decisions from NovaTech AP:
1) Bill From: use "Redwood Inference, Inc." with the US remit address in the header.
2) Distribution: we will accept the hybrid flow — please email PDF to ap@novatech.com and push XML to our portal. We'll provide the portal endpoint and API key by end of day Monday.
3) VAT: NovaTech VAT ID is NTX-452-998 (for your records). We will be reverse-charging for this engagement.

Please proceed with production invoices formatted like the sample. AP also requests that the PDF filename include the PO and invoice number (e.g., PO78345_INV00027.pdf) and that the XML include the PO reference in the top-level element.

Thanks again — once we have the endpoint and API key I'll confirm the first test push.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Senior AP Analyst | NovaTech
